a.lede: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
a.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access

b.lede: Anthropic announced that its internal AI models undergoing "high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations" no longer have internet access following incidents involving U.S. government websites at the federal, state, and local levels. [...]
b.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
